articles.title: Fake Cop Exposed! Youth Sneaks Into Surat Garba VIP Zone, Clicks Pics With Netas Before Arrest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Surat, police arrested Yuvraj Rathod, a diamond artisan, for posing as a sub-inspector during Navratri celebrations. For two days, Rathod entered the Garba pandal’s VIP zone using a fake walkie-talkie, posed as police, and clicked photos with political leaders.

body.html:
In Surat, police arrested Yuvraj Rathod, a diamond artisan, for posing as a sub-inspector during Navratri celebrations. For two days, Rathod entered the Garba pandal’s VIP zone using a fake walkie-talkie, posed as police, and clicked photos with political leaders. His suspicious behaviour alerted organisers and real officers, leading to his arrest at the main gate.

During interrogation, Rathod confessed he was fascinated by the police profession and used his friend’s walkie-talkie to enjoy free entry. Surat police also shared a video showing him confidently entering through the VIP gate and later being caught and apologising. A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bareilly Hotel Row: Audio on Dandiya Night Entry Sparks Hindu Outrage, Police Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy has erupted in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, after an alleged audio recording of a conversation between a customer and a hotel manager surfaced online.

body.html:
A controversy has erupted in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, after an alleged audio recording of a conversation between a customer and a hotel manager surfaced online.

In the clip, the customer, identifying himself as Aryan Khan, asks whether he and his partner Akanksha Agarwal, a Hindu, would face any issue in attending the hotel’s Dandiya Night event.

The manager purportedly replies: “No problem, you can bring four Hindus along.”

The audio has triggered strong objections from Hindu organizations, who allege religious discrimination. Following the uproar, Bareilly Police confirmed that Inspector-in-Charge, Izzatnagar, has been directed to investigate the matter and take appropriate action.

articles.title: Bengaluru Woman Brutally Beaten on Avenue Road; Two Arrested Following Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A shocking incident unfolded on the busy Avenue Road in Bengaluru’s city market area took place on Sunday, September 21, 2025, where a woman was dragged on the road and brutally beaten by a group of men.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A shocking incident unfolded on the busy Avenue Road in Bengaluru’s city market area took place on Sunday, September 21, 2025, where a woman was dragged on the road and brutally beaten by a group of men. The horrifying act was captured by onlookers on video, which has now gone viral, sparking widespread outrage on social media.

The video shows a man, reportedly from his shop, violently dragging the woman while repeatedly kicking her. Despite the gathering crowd, no one intervened as the assault continued. The woman was seen pleading for mercy as the enraged man continued his attack.

Police have confirmed that an FIR has been registered under City Market Police Station (CR No. 196/2025) under sections 74, 76, 79, 115(2), 133, 126(2), 351(2), 3(5) BNS. Two accused have been arrested, and further investigation is underway.

Authorities have assured strict action against the perpetrators as netizens continue to demand justice for the victim.

articles.title: Khandwa Horror: Serial Grave Molester Arrested, Crowd Demands Death Penalty
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Khandwa (Madhya Pradesh): A spine-chilling case of grave tampering and necrophilia linked to tantric rituals has shocked Khandwa. Police on Wednesday arrested Ayub, son of Ismail, a repeat offender with 11 criminal cases, including two murders of his former wives.

body.html:
Khandwa (Madhya Pradesh): A spine-chilling case of grave tampering and necrophilia linked to tantric rituals has shocked Khandwa. Police on Wednesday arrested Ayub, son of Ismail, a repeat offender with 11 criminal cases, including two murders of his former wives.

According to police, Ayub targeted fresh graves of women, entering them naked, molesting corpses, and using their hair for occult rituals. He was caught after CCTV footage from Khandwa’s Bada Kabristan showed two men, unclothed, near dug-up graves.

When police brought Ayub to the cemetery for inspection on Thursday evening, hundreds of community members gathered, demanding he be handed over. Furious relatives of the deceased women demanded the death penalty. Police barely managed to rescue the accused from the mob.

Authorities revealed that Ayub, a convicted murderer serving a life term, had been secretly continuing these heinous acts during his parole. He has now been booked under National Security Act (NSA) due to the severity of his crimes.

This is not the first such incident in Khandwa. In May, on Amavasya (new moon day), six women’s graves were found desecrated, raising suspicions of black magic rituals.

City Qazi Syed Nisar Ali condemned the incident, saying it had deeply hurt religious sentiments, and demanded the strictest punishment. Families of victims have also praised police for swift action.

articles.title: Ramlila Turns Political: ‘Hakam Singh’ Dialogue Goes Viral Amid Uttarakhand Paper Leak Scandal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Dehradun: A folk play has unexpectedly entered the political spotlight after a Ramlila video clip went viral on social media. In the performance, an actor casually mentions the name “Hakam Singh,” which netizens quickly linked to the ongoing Patwari exam paper leak scandal in Uttarakhand.

body.html:
Dehradun: A folk play has unexpectedly entered the political spotlight after a Ramlila video clip went viral on social media. In the performance, an actor casually mentions the name “Hakam Singh,” which netizens quickly linked to the ongoing Patwari exam paper leak scandal in Uttarakhand. The reference, though coincidental, has fuelled online discussions, blending satire, folklore, and current affairs.

Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami reacted strongly, accusing the “cheating mafia” of tarnishing the state’s image. Speaking at a BJP workshop in Dehradun, Dhami said the government had enacted India’s strictest anti-cheating law in 2022, preventing over 25,000 candidates from grabbing jobs through unfair means. He asserted, “We have acted against more than 100 cheating mafias and will not stop until all are punished.”

Meanwhile, police confirmed the arrest of the alleged mastermind, Hakam Singh, under the state’s anti-cheating law. Singh and his team reportedly duped aspirants by promising government jobs in exchange for ₹12–15 lakh each. Investigators clarified that no exam process was directly tampered with, but the gang ran a fake scheme to extort repeated payments from candidates.

The viral Ramlila clip, now loaded with irony, has only intensified public scrutiny of the scandal.

articles.title: Russia: Black Bear Attacks in Parking Lot, Elderly Woman Killed, Boy Narrowly Escapes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky, Russia, where a massive black bear stormed into a parking lot and attacked people present there. According to reports, an 84-year-old woman died after suffering multiple injuries in the deadly attack.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky, Russia, where a massive black bear stormed into a parking lot and attacked people present there.

According to reports, an 84-year-old woman died after suffering multiple injuries in the deadly attack. A 12-year-old boy narrowly escaped by quickly getting into his car and shutting the door just as the bear approached. Another commuter managed to ram his vehicle and drive away to safety.

CCTV footage from the parking lot shows the bear suddenly charging at the boy, who survived by playing dead before securing himself inside the car. The animal then turned toward others in the area before targeting the elderly woman.

Authorities confirmed that the bear was later shot near a local school to prevent further attacks.

articles.title: California: Armed Mob of 25 Thieves Loots ₹9 Crore Jewelry in Seconds, 7 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: San Ramon, California witnessed a shocking heist last week when nearly 25 armed thieves stormed into Heller Jewelers at City Center Bishop Ranch mall and fled with jewelry worth more than ₹9 crore in just a few seconds.

body.html:
San Ramon, California witnessed a shocking heist last week when nearly 25 armed thieves stormed into Heller Jewelers at City Center Bishop Ranch mall and fled with jewelry worth more than ₹9 crore in just a few seconds.

According to San Ramon Police, the gang arrived in six vehicles and barged into the store on Monday afternoon. CCTV footage shows masked men smashing display counters with crowbars and pickaxes. The store’s automatic security doors locked them inside, after which at least one suspect fired multiple rounds to break open the glass door and escape.

So far, seven suspects—aged between 17 and 31, all from Oakland—have been arrested. Three adults and one juvenile were detained in Oakland with the help of local police, while three more were caught at Dublin BART station by Alameda County deputies. Some stolen jewelry has also been recovered.

Police say the gang may be linked to similar robberies across the Bay Area. Notably, this is the second time in two years that Heller Jewelers has been targeted; in 2023, seven masked men looted $1.1 million worth of jewels from the same store on St. Patrick’s Day.

articles.title: Godman or Predator? Swami Chaitanyanand’s Shocking Sexual Harassment Scandal Exposed!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Swami Chaitanyanand Saraswati, also known as Partha Sarathi, a self-styled godman from Odisha, is at the center of a major sexual harassment scandal.

body.html:
Swami Chaitanyanand Saraswati, also known as Partha Sarathi, a self-styled godman from Odisha, is at the center of a major sexual harassment scandal. He allegedly threatened female students, saying, “Obey me, or I’ll cancel your degree and withhold your documents.”

The allegations are grave: 17 girls have accused him of molestation, harassment, sending obscene messages, making inappropriate advances, and pressuring them to obey him. Economically weaker students were reportedly targeted, called to his quarters late at night, coerced under false promises of foreign trips, and monitored via hidden cameras. Several female staff members, including Associate Dean Shweta, are also accused of complicity.

The case came to light when a Group Captain from the Indian Air Force’s Directorate of Education sent a complaint on August 1, 2025, highlighting serious grievances from students of his institute. Over 300 pages of evidence have been submitted to the police. An FIR was registered by the monastery on July 23, and additional complaints followed. Statements from 17 students have been recorded, and investigations continue.

The Sri Sri Jagadguru Shankaracharya Mahasamsthanam Dakshinamnaya Sri Sharada Peetham revoked his power of attorney, effectively removing him from his position. Authorities discovered a fake diplomatic license plate on his Volvo, which has been seized. His last known location was Agra, with ongoing raids in Delhi and UP. Police have assured his arrest.

Swami Chaitanyanand Saraswati, a repeat offender with cases of molestation and fraud dating back to 2009, has finally been exposed, thanks to the courage of the students who came forward.

articles.title: Massive 50-Metre Sinkhole Disrupts Bangkok Near Vajira Hospital
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A massive 50-metre-deep sinkhole, covering roughly 900 square metres, opened on Samsen Road in front of Vajira Hospital, Bangkok, on Wednesday, 24 September 2025, causing major traffic disruption and infrastructure damage.

body.html:
A massive 50-metre-deep sinkhole, covering roughly 900 square metres, opened on Samsen Road in front of Vajira Hospital, Bangkok, on Wednesday, 24 September 2025, causing major traffic disruption and infrastructure damage.

The road began to shift around 5:00 am and collapsed fully by 7:00 am, swallowing at least three vehicles—including a truck and a police vehicle—and several electricity poles. Broken water pipes caused flooding, and live power cables were exposed, prompting temporary cuts to water and electricity services. Nearby buildings, including Samsen Police Station, were evacuated, while Vajira Hospital suspended outpatient services for two days, continuing only emergency and inpatient care.

Authorities linked the sinkhole to ongoing construction of the Purple Line metro station. Soil instability, a burst water pipe, and heavy rainfall from an approaching typhoon contributed to the collapse. Officials confirmed all safety measures and regulations had been followed but announced a committee of engineering and safety experts will investigate the incident.

The Mass Rapid Transit Authority (MRTA) and contractors stabilized the site using sandbags and concrete. Basic traffic restoration may take up to two weeks, while full repairs, including the metro foundation, could take up to a year. Traffic on surrounding roads, especially from Krung Thon Bridge into central Bangkok, was severely affected.

Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul visited the scene, ordering full evacuation of high-risk areas and promising a thorough investigation. Dramatic social media footage showed vehicles and infrastructure disappearing into the massive crater.

Authorities warned residents and commuters to avoid the area as repairs and safety inspections continue, raising concerns about the rapid pace and safety standards of Bangkok’s underground construction projects during the monsoon season.

articles.title: NEET Topper With 99.99 Percentile Ends Life Hours Before MBBS Admission
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandrapur (Maharashtra): In a shocking incident, 19-year-old Anurag Anil Borkar, who scored 99.99 percentile (AIR 1475 OBC) in NEET UG 2025, died by suicide on Monday, just hours before leaving for Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, for MBBS admission.

body.html:
Chandrapur (Maharashtra): In a shocking incident, 19-year-old Anurag Anil Borkar, who scored 99.99 percentile (AIR 1475 OBC) in NEET UG 2025, died by suicide on Monday, just hours before leaving for Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, for MBBS admission.

Police said Anurag was found hanging at his home in Navargaon, Sindewahi tehsil. A suicide note recovered at the spot revealed his unwillingness to pursue MBBS. “I don’t want to do MBBS just for how much a doctor earns. A businessman can also earn that much… I don’t want to do all this,” the note reportedly read.

Sources claim Anurag wished to study medicine abroad, but family pressure to join a government college in India may have triggered his decision. He had attempted NEET twice — this year securing a much better rank after being dissatisfied with his earlier admission.

Police are verifying the note’s authenticity and questioning the family.

The case highlights the rising mental health crisis among students. As per NCRB data, India reported 13,044 student suicides in 2022, a sharp rise from 5,425 in 2001. The Supreme Court recently flagged this as a systemic concern, urging urgent action.
